run_inverse_kinematics_pole: run the pybullet inverse kinematics pole example that animates a pole end-effector along a circular trajectory
calculate_inverse_kinematics: calculate inverse kinematics for a URDF robot end-effector target position using pybullet calculateInverseKinematics
reset_joint_state: reset a robot joint state to a computed position using pybullet resetJointState ignoring dynamics
get_link_state: get the current link state and end-effector pose of a loaded URDF robot using pybullet getLinkState
add_user_debug_line: add a debug visualization line to trace target and actual end-effector positions in the pybullet viewer
